rule.rule_text: To add a new show: (1) copy this file's record shapes; (2) fill continuity_state records for series looks, per-location plates, and each approved track's end state; (3) add prompt_pair records from previous end state + script beat + assets -> the locked prompt actually used; (4) add qc_example records from real renders only;  (5) keep show-agnostic rules in rules.jsonl, and put show-specific locks in that show's jsonl; (6) never invent facts — use null; (7) set is_example_template false on real data; (8) run convert_to_chat.py to rebuild train_chat.jsonl.
rule.rationale: The package is meant to be reused for shows beyond Ultimate Warrior.
rule.good_example: A new show folder yields verified end-states and QC from saved prompts and selected takes, with source_paths pointing at those files.
rule.bad_example: Template records are left labeled as real training data, or end-states are invented because prompts were not yet saved.

rule.rule_text: Never change dialogue. Copy it byte-for-byte from the script.
rule.rationale: Stated at the top of the short bible; same standing rule used across shows.
rule.good_example: Episode lines are pasted unchanged from raw/ep01.txt … ep16.txt.
rule.bad_example: A line is polished or translated before it goes into the prompt.

rule.rule_text: Madhav's thread stack and knot-marks stay on the RIGHT wrist: Maa's red thread (never burns), iron thread above it, blue-black mark, and later knot-marks. Each saved life binds part of his strength, shown as a knot-mark and a weak right hand. The iron thread digs in when the power rises.
rule.rationale: Short bible watch-out: 'Everything on the RIGHT wrist.'
rule.good_example: A close-up names the right wrist, red thread, iron thread above it, and the current number of knot-marks.
rule.bad_example: The thread is moved to the left wrist, or knot-marks disappear after a save, or the box is shown the same size after taking blood (the box keeps shrinking).

rule.rule_text: If a script asks for an effect that conflicts with a standing pipeline rule (for example red eye shine versus a general no-eye-glow rule), do not drop the effect and do not invent a lock. Flag it as an open question for the director.
rule.rationale: Short bible watch-out: 'The scripts call for red eye shine on Rudra. Confirm whether that's allowed in gens.'
rule.good_example: The prompt draft notes the scripted red eye shine and asks the director before generating.
rule.bad_example: The shine is deleted to satisfy a different show's no-eye-glow rule, or glowing eyes are added to other characters.

characters.name: Madhav
characters.costume: 28, lean, wheat-brown, left-eyebrow cut. Delivery jacket (Ep2), then grey-blue guard uniform (Ep3-4), then a black wool shawl (Ep8+). RIGHT wrist: Maa's red thread, iron thread above it, blue-black mark, later 2 knot-marks.

characters.name: Rudra
characters.costume: Medium brown, sharp face. Orange helmet and dusty jacket in Lahaul (Ep1). Full-sleeve shirt and jeans with a trolley bag (Ep2). Charcoal shirt (Ep14). Bandaged right palm hidden by his cuff. Red stain near the jaw. Red eye shine (confirm for gens). Straightens his cuff before violence.
props: Blood Rock Box (trolley bag / pocket / hand)

characters.name: Raktabeej
characters.costume: Iron-black body, torn bronze armour, chest wound. Calm, doubled voice. Full form in Ep1 only, then through the box and shadows.

characters.name: Maa Kali
characters.costume: Blue-black skin, open hair, skull mala, khappar and khadga. Full form in Ep1 only. Later the murti, the blue-black flame and the carved khappar (Ep6-7).

characters.name: Bindiya
characters.costume: Dusky, ink-stained fingers. Short printed kurti, thrifted jeans, sneakers, high ponytail with a claw clip, hoops, notebook. Thin red thread on her RIGHT wrist that now glows blue-black.

characters.name: Maa
characters.costume: Thin, pale, greying bun, faded saree with the pallu over her head, weak. Red thread at her neck (Ep15).

characters.name: Devraj (Baba)
characters.costume: Old, dark, white beard, one clouded eye, limp. Pahadi coat, wool cap, rudraksh mala, iron bell under his shirt.

characters.name: Keshav Vartak
characters.costume: 50s, light brown, kurta and waistcoat, gold ring he turns, mithai. Soft and polite.

characters.name: Mane
characters.costume: Late 30s, heavy, stubble, rolled sleeves, gold chain.

characters.name: Charu Deshmukh
characters.costume: 28, reporter, deep-brown, khadi shirt, always recording on her phone.

props.name: Blood Rock Box
props.condition: Shrinks every time it takes blood. Kept in the trolley bag, the pocket or his hand.

props.name: Thread stack
props.condition: Red thread (never burns), iron thread, black shawl, Devraj's bell.
